Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 3
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted the task and asserted a factual error, stating “The first governor-general of India was Warren Hastings, appointed in 1784.” This conflates “Governor-General in India (of Bengal)” (Warren Hastings, 1773–1785) with the later title “Governor-General of India” (first officially Lord William Bentinck, 1833). The Planner also drifted from the user’s ask about the “position” to “who” and biographical details, reinforcing the initial misinterpretation and propagating the incorrect premise.
